g.text: UCD-1 / ReturnOps AU System Use-Case Model
Criterion C3 Candidate — System Boundary, Stakeholders, External Providers, and Dependency Semantics
ReturnOps AU — Single-Store Returns Management System
Customer Intake & Clarification (B UI / A Domain)
Audit & Transparency (A service / B UI / C provenance)
Review Proposal or Record Manual Outcome
View Case, Evidence, Citations, and Risks
Execute Approved Simulated Return and Label
Inspect Case Status and Audit Trail
to avoid misrepresenting temporal order as functional decomposition.)
Proposal-bound ESCALATE permits lawful revision/manual handling,
never direct approval. Only actual no-proposal failure/block
targets are manual-only. A second REVISE remains REVISE with
the current proposal when the automatic budget is exhausted.
Customer clarification follows current question-set/state guards;
it has no fixed three-round cap.
